title: Trump and Xi set for second day of talks after Taiwan warning
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set to meet on Friday to wrap up a two-day state visit that has featured pomp and business deals but also a stark warning from Xi that mishandling the Taiwan issue could push U.S.-China relations to “a very dangerous ‌place.”

title: US Justice Dept close to dropping charges against India’s Gautam Adani, sources say
byline: The U.S. Justice Department is close to dropping criminal fraud charges against Gautam Adani, an Indian billionaire who has promised to invest $10 billion in the U.S. economy, according to two sources familiar with the matter.

title: Avissawella records highest rainfall as heavy showers affect island-wide river basins
byline: The highest rainfall recorded during the 24-hour period ending at 5.00 a.m. today (15) was observed in the Avissawella area, amid adverse weather conditions affecting the island.

title: Schools in Hatton Education Zone closed today due to bad weather
byline: Due to the prevailing heavy rainfall across Sri Lanka, a special holiday has been declared today (15) for all schools within the Hatton Education Zone.

title: Multiple reservoirs across Sri Lanka spill amid ongoing heavy rainfall
byline: The Department of Irrigation reports that 21 major reservoirs and more than 19 medium-scale reservoirs under its management are currently spilling.

title: Very heavy showers above 150 mm likely in some areas today
byline: According to the Department of Meteorology, the low-pressure area located northeast of Sri Lanka persists.

title: Death toll from adverse weather in Sri Lanka rises to two
byline: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) states that a total of two deaths have been reported as a result of the disaster situation affecting several districts across the island.

title: 88 houses partially damaged across seven districts due to bad weather - DMC
byline: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) reports that 88 houses across the island have sustained partial damage due to prevailing adverse weather conditions in Sri Lanka.

title: Trump says China wants to buy oil from US
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said China wants to buy ⁠oil from the United States.

title: Minor flood warning issued for Kuda Ganga sub-basin of Kalu River
byline: The Department of Irrigation has issued a minor flood warning for the next 48 hours regarding the Kuda Ganga sub-basin of the Kalu River.

title: Sri Lanka and Belarus sign MoU to strengthen health sector cooperation
byline: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath, who is currently on an official visit to Belarus, stated that he held discussions with Belarusian Minister of Health Aliaksandr Khajayeu on expanding cooperation in the health sector between Sri Lanka and Belarus.

title: Provincial Council elections will be held within this year - Minister
byline: The Minister of Science and Technology, Chrishantha Abeyasena, has stated that the Provincial Council elections will definitely be held within this year.

title: Red warning issued for heavy rains; system expected to recede within 36 hours
byline: A red warning for heavy rainfall in several areas of the country has been issued by the Department of Meteorology.

title: Trump leaves China after talks dominated by trade, oil and Taiwan
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump departed Beijing Friday after two days of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping that ran the gamut from Iran and Taiwan to trade, oil and Boeing.

title: India hikes petrol, diesel prices more than 3%, retailers say
byline: India has raised petrol and diesel prices for the first time in four years by 3 rupees ($0.03) per litre, or more than 3%, according to retailers in Delhi on Friday, to recoup some of the losses incurred due to higher global crude oil prices.

title: CAA takes legal action against traders overcharging for Samba rice
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) states that legal action has been initiated against a group of traders in the Marawila area for selling Samba rice above the government-mandated Maximum Retail Price (MRP).

title: Sanath Nishantha’s brother sentenced to prison
byline: The former Chairman of the Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha, Jagath Samantha, has been sentenced to five and a half years of imprisonment after being found guilty of assaulting the Divisional Secretary of Arachchikattuwa.

title: Scientists dig up Southeast Asia’s largest dinosaur in Thailand
byline: Along a meandering river in a warm and arid region that is now Thailand roughly 113 million years ago, a plant-eating behemoth almost 90 feet (27 meters) long browsed on the treetops without much fear of predators due to its sheer size.

title: NBRO extends landslide warnings amid heavy rainfall across Sri Lanka
byline: Taking into account the prevailing heavy rainfall across Sri Lanka, the National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) has extended the landslide early warnings issued last night (14).

title: 74 Vietnamese nationals further remanded over alleged online scams
byline: The Fort Magistrate’s Court has ordered that 74 Vietnamese nationals arrested and remanded on suspicion of involvement in online financial scams be further remanded until May 21.

title: New outbreak of Ebola kills 65 in eastern DR Congo
byline: Africa’s top health agency has declared an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern Ituri province.

title: US Dollar selling rate exceeds Rs. 331
byline: The selling price of the US Dollar has exceeded Rs. 331 against the Sri Lankan Rupee.

title: Indian passenger arrested at BIA with over 2kg of cocaine
byline: A foreign national passenger was arrested at the arrival terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) by officers of the Customs Narcotics Control Unit while attempting to smuggle a stock of cocaine valued at around Rs. 108 million through the ‘Green Channel’ this morning (15).

title: CBSL launches online complaint management system for financial consumers
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) has announced the launch of an online Complaint Management System (CMS), marking a significant step to facilitate the submission of complaints and grievances by financial consumers relating to Financial Service Providers (FSPs) regulated by CBSL.

title: Beckham becomes UK’s first billionaire sportsman
byline: Former England captain Sir David Beckham has become the UK’s first billionaire sportsman in the 2026 Sunday Times Rich List.

title: Trump says US and China are aligned on Iran, Tehran must make a deal soon
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said his patience with Iran was running out and that Chinese President Xi Jinping had agreed during their talks in Beijing that Tehran must reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: UK anti-immigration social media accounts traced to Sri Lanka and Vietnam – BBC
byline: A major BBC News investigation has revealed that a network of “patriotic” UK anti-immigration social media accounts was actually traced back to users in Sri Lanka and Vietnam.

title: 23 monks remanded over drug smuggling urged to voluntarily disrobe
byline: The Registrars of the three main Buddhist chapters (Nikayas) in Sri Lanka have requested 23 arrested monks, who are currently in remand custody over allegations of smuggling narcotics from Thailand, to voluntarily disrobe to return to lay life.

title: Sufficient fuel stocks available until August, requests already made for remaining months – officials
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has stated that the government has managed the energy crisis in a way that does not cause hardship to the public, unlike in some other countries, by bearing the associated costs without placing a burden on the people and by implementing a sustainable management process.

title: Expansion of PayPal services in Sri Lanka officially announced
byline: Marking a significant milestone in the digital economy, the official announcement on the expansion of PayPal services in Sri Lanka was made this morning (16) at the Galle Face Hotel under the patronage of Prime Minister Dr Harini Amarasuriya.

title: High-level ICC team to reach Sri Lanka – report
byline: A high-level ICC team, including a top BCCI official, is reaching Sri Lanka in the aftermath of the government’s appointment of an interim committee to run Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC), Indian media reported.

title: Magnitude 6.3 earthquake hits northern Japan, no tsunami warning issued
byline: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 6.3 hit northern Japan on Friday, ⁠the Japan Meteorological Agency said.

title: India deepens defence, energy ties with UAE during PM Modi visit
byline: India and the United Arab Emirates agreed the framework for a strategic defence partnership on Friday, the Indian foreign ministry said, as they seek to deepen ties amid the Iran war.

title: Economists warn soaring US Dollar rate could pressure Sri Lanka’s economy
byline: Economists warn that if the Sri Lankan rupee continues to depreciate, fuel prices, electricity and water tariffs, as well as the prices of goods and services, could increase in the future.

title: Xi to pay state visit to U.S. in autumn this year
byline: Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States in autumn this year at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese top diplomat Wang Yi said on Friday.

title: Sri Lankan Rupee depreciating at unprecedented speed, warns Dilith Jayaweera
byline: The leader of ‘Sarvajana Balaya’, Member of Parliament (MP) Dilith Jayaweera, states that the Sri Lankan Rupee is currently depreciating even faster than during the country’s worst economic collapse.
